Hiring: Agentic AI Engineers

We are looking for experienced Agentic AI Engineers to join our team and work on next-generation Multi-Agent AI solutions.

Role: AI Engineer Agentic AI
Location: Pan India
Experience: 8+ Years

Must-Have Skills

Strong Python programming
GCP & Vertex AI Mandatory
Agentic AI / Multi-Agent Systems (MAS)
Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) or similar frameworks
Sequential & loop-based agent workflows
AI Evaluation Precision, Recall, F1, trajectory analysis & faithfulness
LLM concepts – SFT, CoT & ReAct
Multi-agent architecture & data processing
Agent deployment on cloud
Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows
Interrupt & Resume patterns
Debugging & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
Strong communication & customer collaboration skills

Good-to-Have Skills

A2A / MCP
CI/CD for Multi-Agent applications
LLM integration with Knowledge Graphs
Agent memory / Memory Bank
Agile development experience




Interested candidates can share their updated resumes / profiles.
